summary: Narrow bush-side street where cars park; homes about 20m away, steep.

best_section.where: Carmody Road side street south kerb, after the first bend, beside the pool-house gardens

drivers.seclusion: Bush bank opposite; nearest dwelling about 21m on own side, others 8m at 73m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the narrow lane edge; a van probably fits but it is tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars along kerb, but 2P resident-permit signs apply on weekdays.

flags: Steep: about 11% over the section, 12% overall
sun_shade: Mixed: bush canopy opposite gives afternoon shade, open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether a van fits between parked cars and trees
